statement: For the full 144-real-coordinate adapted linear two-root chart h2=t H xi1, H in R^(12x12), formed by simultaneous antipodal roots +/-p and +/-2p in the canonical A1 six-real convention, with p a nonzero admissible dual-lattice momentum and all four modes retained by the cutoff, zero deterministic strict-past control, stationary common-even Gaussian background, and common-even scalar regulator multipliers bounded by one, the exact A7 covariance-normal endpoint has zero first variation and, for every H != 0, an endpoint Hessian strictly bounded below by -4/5 ||H||_F^2. The radial rational certificate is uniform for every x=|p|^2 >= 0. The exact 9/20 Cameron-Martin source cost has Hessian 9/10 ||H||_F^2 and the terminal sixth-power Hessian is nonnegative, so for H != 0 the augmented local action Hessian is strictly greater than 1/10 ||H||_F^2. The proof differentiates the complete endpoint once, with the spatial-gradient index summed explicitly, uses the R-130 six-real pointwise Hessian envelope, the exact A1 mass floor M>(7/250)I, and a rational Sturm certificate with no positive roots. Forest, balanced, future, trace, and low descriptions are alternate expansions or estimates of the same fixed terminal owner and cannot be fabricated as independent reserves. The theorem is local in control amplitude and does not cover non-lattice or unretained momenta, nonzero past means, nonlinear feedback, interacting root pairs, or the complete directed source union; T-050, A13, Nelson, every phase/PDE verdict, and Sector A remain open.
